# models.codelove.in — 6,792 free 3D models (GLB)

> A free library of 6,792 ready-to-use 3D models: 115 rigged human characters with 20 animation clips, animals, vehicles, buildings, furniture, food, nature, trees, space, weapons and game kits. Every model is one glTF 2.0 binary file (.glb) with a direct download URL — no sign-up, no API key — and free for personal and commercial use (MIT, CC0 or public domain; a few hairstyles are CC BY / CC BY-ND and need credit).

Site: https://models.codelove.in/ · Made by Gowtham

Use it when you need:
- free 3D models or game assets for three.js, react-three-fiber, Babylon.js, A-Frame or WebXR projects (other glTF engines too — see Using the files);
- low-poly kits to build cities, roads, dungeons, castles, pirate islands, farms, restaurants or space bases;
- rigged, animated people (adults, children, professions) and animals — 275 rigged models in all;
- models an AI coding agent can load by URL straight into a prototype.

## Find models without crawling the site

- [Every model in one file](https://models.codelove.in/llms-full.txt): Markdown, one line per model — name, model page, .glb path, triangles, size, file size, license notes. Paths are relative to https://models.codelove.in.
- [catalog.json](https://models.codelove.in/catalog.json): the same data as JSON for scripts (`models[].glb` is relative to `url`).
- One collection at a time: https://models.codelove.in/llms/<collection>.md — listed under Collections below, with absolute URLs.
- Model page: https://models.codelove.in/models/<slug>/ (3D preview, downloads, license). Category pages: https://models.codelove.in/models/category/<category>/. Sitemap: https://models.codelove.in/sitemap.xml.
- The .glb files and these catalog files can be fetched from any website (CORS allows every origin), so a web app can load models straight from this site.

## Using the files

- Format: glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), one file per model with textures embedded, compressed with EXT_meshopt_compression and EXT_texture_webp. three.js (GLTFLoader + MeshoptDecoder; drei's useGLTF sets this up) and Babylon.js load them directly; other engines need meshopt support or a decompressed copy.
- Size is the bounding box (width × height × depth) in glTF units, which are metres by the glTF spec; models are Y-up. A few imported models are not to real-world scale, so scale them to fit.
- Rigged humans use a Biped skeleton (root bone Bip01; the child characters use Bip02). The 20 animation clips (10 motions: idle, look around, talk, thoughtful, wave, cheer, clap, dance, walk, run) are separate skeleton-only .glb files in a female (f_) and a male (m_) set: load a character and a clip from its set, then play the clip with THREE.AnimationMixer — the bone names match.
- Each .glb carries its license and credit in the glTF asset block (asset.copyright, asset.extras).

Load a model in three.js:

```js
import { GLTFLoader } from "three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js";
import { MeshoptDecoder } from "three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js";

const loader = new GLTFLoader().setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);
const gltf = await loader.loadAsync("https://models.codelove.in/library/car-kit/police.glb"); // Police
scene.add(gltf.scene);
```

## Licenses

- MIT License — 142 models and all 20 animation clips: Keep the included license file with the model when you ship or share it. https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT
- CC0 1.0 — public domain — 6,392 models: No attribution required. https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Public domain — 244 models: No attribution required; don't use insignia or logos shown on the model to imply endorsement. https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/
- CC BY 4.0 — 11 models: Credit the author (named on the model page, in the file and in ATTRIBUTION.txt) when you use or share it. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- CC BY-ND 4.0 — 3 models: Credit the author (named on the model page, in the file and in ATTRIBUTION.txt) when you use or share it, and share only unmodified copies. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/

Every model page names its license; the full texts and a per-collection table are at https://models.codelove.in/license/.

- [Characters](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/characters/): 165 models — Rigged people, professions and stylized characters
- [Animals](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/animals/): 114 models — Farm animals, pets, birds and creatures
- [Vehicles](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/vehicles/): 472 models — Cars, trucks, trains, boats and karts
- [Buildings](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/buildings/): 1,857 models — Houses, city blocks, castles and roads
- [Furniture](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/furniture/): 278 models — Home, kitchen, office and outdoor furniture
- [Food](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/food/): 350 models — Meals, fruit, drinks and restaurant props
- [Nature](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/nature/): 446 models — Plants, flowers, rocks and terrain
- [Trees](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/trees/): 153 models — Oaks, pines, palms, autumn and snowy trees
- [Space](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/space/): 586 models — Spacecraft, rovers, planets and space bases
- [Weapons](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/weapons/): 105 models — Swords, shields, bows, blasters and siege engines
- [Skeletons](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/skeletons/): 18 models — Undead skeleton warriors, mages, rogues and dungeon armaments
- [Ghosts](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/ghosts/): 13 models — Spooky ghosts, haunting spirits and floating phantoms for horror and Halloween games
- [Bikes](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/bikes/): 10 models — Motorcycles, racing road bikes, choppers, and urban cycles
- [Gaming](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/gaming/): 23 models — Arcade machines, combat soldiers, battle arenas and RPG loot
- [Hair](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/hair/): 6 models — Long, bob, bun and anime hairstyles by Sketchfab artists (credit the author)
- [God of War](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/god-of-war/): 17 models — Kratos, Spartan champions, archers and mythological deities
- [Props](https://models.codelove.in/models/category/props/): 2,179 models — Game kits, dungeons, tools and decorations

## Optional

- [Download packs](https://models.codelove.in/packs/): every collection as one .zip (built in the browser), plus all animation clips.
- [Animations](https://models.codelove.in/animations/): preview the 20 clips on a character and download them.
- [Scene builder](https://models.codelove.in/builder/): compose scenes from any model in the browser and export one .glb.
- [Scene builder tutorials](https://models.codelove.in/tutorials/): narrated step-by-step videos of scenes being built, with written steps and transcripts.
- [GLB viewer](https://models.codelove.in/viewer/): open a local .glb to preview, recolor and inspect it.
- [For developers & AI](https://models.codelove.in/developers/): these files explained, with code samples.
- [Free 3D games online](https://games.codelove.in/): free 3D games built only from these models, on games.codelove.in — no download, no sign-up, on PC or phone.
- [Patti Veedu](https://games.codelove.in/patti-veedu/): free 3D game (horror puzzle) built only from these models — Grandma's house. Five nights. Listen for her anklet bells.
- [Skate Rush](https://games.codelove.in/skate-rush/): free 3D game (endless runner) built only from these models — Skate through the city, dodge the traffic, grab every coin.
- [Saucer Siege](https://games.codelove.in/saucer-siege/): free 3D game (tower defense) built only from these models — Medieval towers versus flying saucers. Hold the valley!
- [Cannon Cove](https://games.codelove.in/cannon-cove/): free 3D game (naval trading & action) built only from these models — Trade across the open sea, build a fleet, battle friends online.
- [Crypt Knight](https://games.codelove.in/crypt-knight/): free 3D game (action roguelite) built only from these models — Sword, shield and a crypt full of restless skeletons.
- [Order Up!](https://games.codelove.in/order-up/): free 3D game (cooking time management) built only from these models — Grill, stack and serve burgers before the customers walk out.
- [Hex Haven](https://games.codelove.in/hex-haven/): free 3D game (puzzle) built only from these models — Lay hex tiles, match the edges, grow a tiny kingdom.
- [Sky Hop](https://games.codelove.in/sky-hop/): free 3D game (3d platformer) built only from these models — Run, double-jump and stomp across floating sky islands.
- [Turbo Karts](https://games.codelove.in/turbo-karts/): free 3D game (kart racing) built only from these models — Drift, boost and banana-slip your way to the podium.
- [Siege Smash](https://games.codelove.in/siege-smash/): free 3D game (physics puzzle) built only from these models — Aim the trebuchet, topple the towers, rout the defenders.
- [Beat Street](https://games.codelove.in/beat-street/): free 3D game (rhythm) built only from these models — Hit the notes on the beat and make the crowd dance.
- [Putt Paradise](https://games.codelove.in/putt-paradise/): free 3D game (mini golf) built only from these models — Nine dreamy mini-golf holes. Ramps, loops and windmills.
- [Kingdom Clash](https://games.codelove.in/kingdom-clash/): free 3D game (base-building strategy) built only from these models — Build your village, train an army, raid rival villages online and in a 100-stage campaign.
